{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify QA test orders (revenue = '999999.99')
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]

# Check if QA test orders exist
num_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)
print(f"Number of QA test orders found: {num_qa_orders}")

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_orders = sales[refunded_mask]
num_refunded_orders = len(refunded_orders)
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {num_refunded_orders}")

# Filter out QA test orders and refunded orders
valid_sales = sales[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask]
num_valid_sales = len(valid_sales)
print(f"Number of valid orders after filtering: {num_valid_sales}")

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate = valid_sales.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate.idxmax()
best_rate = conversion_rate.max()

# Print the results
print("\nConversion rates by segment:")
print(conversion_rate)
print(f"\nHighest conversion rate: {best_segment} with {best_rate:.2f}%")"}
